title: Reclassification Is All You Missed: Surfacing Variant Reinterpretation Need in Online Health Communities at Population Scale
abstract: arXiv:2611.07054v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Genetic variants are routinely reclassified in ClinVar after a patient is tested, sometimes from uncertain to pathogenic, yet patient recontact is inconsistent, with no clear duty and responsibility diffused among labs, providers, and patients. Many affected people discuss their results in public online health communities that clinical recontact often does not reach. We built PRISM, an agentic large-language-model pipeline that screens these posts, checks whether the variant was later reclassified, and drafts a disclaimer-bearing outreach message, in a no-contact dry run. Across 3.9 million posts from 32 communities, agent-predicted reinterpretation-relevant discussion is rare (0.288%) but concentrated in specialist genetics communities (6.30% versus 0.10% in general medical-advice communities) and growing fivefold since 2014; PRISM surfaces 123 candidate classification differences, 5 of them from an uncertain submission to pathogenic

translated_title: 你错过的只是重新分类：在大规模人群中识别在线健康社区中的基因变异重新解读需求
translated_abstract: 基因变异在患者完成检测后经常会在ClinVar数据库中被重新分类，有时会从“意义未明”变为“致病性”，然而对患者进行重新联系的做法并不一致，责任归属不明确且分散于实验室、医疗服务提供者和患者之间。许多受影响的患者在公共在线健康社区中讨论他们的检测结果，而临床重新联系往往无法触及这些渠道。我们构建了PRISM，这是一个基于智能体的大型语言模型流水线，它能筛选这些帖子、检查相关变异是否随后被重新分类，并起草带有免责声明的联系信息（以无接触试运行方式进行）。在来自32个社区的390万条帖子中，智能体预测的与重新解读相关的讨论较为罕见（0.288%），但高度集中于专业遗传学社区（6.30%，而一般医疗建议社区仅为0.10%），且自2014年以来增长了五倍；PRISM发现了123个候选分类差异，其中5个是从“意义未明”提交升级为“致病性”。
tldr: 研究构建了基于智能体大语言模型的PRISM流水线，能在大规模在线健康社区中筛查基因变异重新解读相关的讨论，发现123个候选分类差异（其中5个从意义未明升级为致病性），从而触及临床重新联系无法覆盖的患者群体。
en_tdlr: PRISM, an agentic LLM pipeline, screens online health communities at population scale for variant reinterpretation-relevant discussions, surfacing 123 candidate classification differences (5 upgraded from uncertain to pathogenic) among patients that clinical recontact often fails to reach.
